purpose: Independent difR (CRAN) reference for binary MH and logistic-regression DIF statistics; numerical agreement only (NOT Type I/power certification).
r: difR::difMH(correct=TRUE, purify=FALSE, match='score') and difR::difLogistic(type='both', criterion='LRT', purify=FALSE)

amendment_v2.added: ETS delta, BH-adjusted p (difR p.adjust.method='BH'), purified MH chi2 (difR purify=TRUE vs production purify=True), uniform LR, Nagelkerke dR2, SIBTEST beta/X2/p vs R mirt::SIBTEST on the fixture anchors
amendment_v2.note: purification algorithms may legitimately differ (iteration rule); a mismatch there is reported, not tuned
amendment_v2.excluded: dif1pl_uniform: 1174 missing responses; observed-score DIF refuses missing data by design (no silent imputation)
